about: The Astronomy drum's six rooms off the spiral, floors 2 to 7 (Interiors' req 919, Godric's 1 on interiors-astronomy-rooms-1022): their doors locked but on class nights, the cloak room's pegs and the lantern room's stand thinned while the class is up and filled again after. The class's nights are the top's (astronomy-tower.json). The other four rooms (telescope store, instrument room, chart room, night books) change by nothing the clock makes, so they say nothing here; the chart room's sky and the night books' moving page are Magic's (req 918).

show: a plain oak door off the stair at every storey, each unlocked and standing ajar
room.canon: Interiors' req 919 (docs/interiors/astronomy-rooms.md, Occupancy and aftermath): the six rooms' doors off the spiral, locked but on class nights (PS 15 L5055, "out-of-bounds except for classes"); unlocked from before the class till after it, which here is the top's own night (astronomy-tower.json, Kingsley's 8a: any dark night, never by day, not over Christmas or Easter), so no door stands open under an empty top; the class's hour PS 8 L2732; both lines read in the canon tool, 22 October 2026
